subtitle: Swap the loading screens for your own images!
description:
Every loading screen shows a random image from a folder of your choice. By default it uses your Minecraft Java screenshots.

Pick a different folder with the Browse button in the Mods tab of the game's settings. Images in its subfolders are used too.

Requirements

  • Blueprint Loader, which loads this mod
  • Native Loader, which loads this mod's DLL

Install

  1. Close the game, and fully close the Minecraft Launcher if you use it.
  2. Open your Minecraft Dungeons II Paks folder.
    • Steam: Right click the game in your library, then Manage > Browse local files, then open Dungeons\Content\Paks
    • Minecraft Launcher: C:\XboxGames\Minecraft Dungeons II\Content\Dungeons\Content\Paks
    If you picked a different install folder in the Minecraft Launcher, it is Minecraft Dungeons II\Content\Dungeons\Content\Paks inside that folder.
  3. Create a folder called ~mods inside the Paks folder if there is not one already.
  4. Open the zip and move the CustomLoadingScreens folder inside it into ~mods, so the files end up like this: Paks\~mods\CustomLoadingScreens\CustomLoadingScreens_P.pak

Uninstall

Delete the CustomLoadingScreens folder from ~mods.
